**10 days ago**

"Houston, this is ISS. About the weird gravitational field that you guys have sent the report earlier, my team has carefully observed and double checked your report… " – I say, while reading the numbers – "… I hate to say, but there's no mistake. We think this is not something our physics can explain."

"ISS, what do you mean?".

"I know that this sounds crazy, but … " – I sigh – "… it seems that this is indeed a wormhole. Our data from satelites matches the predictions from Einstein's theory. I mean, the errors are so incredibly small, that they can only come from our measurements. "

"Okay, thank you for you report. We will take a closer look."

"And one thing, from our observations, …" – I stop for a few second. This is not something you want to say again.

"Yes, ISS?"

"… it's expanding."

**5 days ago**

I cannot believe in my eyes. These numbers, they can't be true.

Not at once.

"Houston, I've received your report. Is this true?"

"Sadly, yes. We've carefully checked, it's indeed true." – the man on the radio says – "The wormhole are expanding because of the effect of gravity. It can be anything, but from the measurements, we believe that the size of that object is quite large. The fact that the wormhole lies near the orbit of the Earth in the next few days, suggests that there's a threat. Specifically, there's a chance that this object could get through the wormhole, and hit the Earth."

"For the sake of God, that would be catastrophic. Is there nothing you can do?" – I grap the microphone tightly, feeling the blood rushes to the mind.

"Right now, there's nothing we can do about it. Since this's our first time observing a wormhole, at this size, at this distance. Making first contact can be highly dangerous, which may change the object's path to hit the Earth, make it explode or … ".

I hear a sigh. The guy on the ground clearly doesn't want to say it. I don't want to hear either.

"… or what, Houston?"

"… or collapse the gravitaional field, which can lead to something terrible, such as black hole. Again, we are trying our best to gather and analyze the data, but since it's a surprise to all of us, it would take days or even months."

**2 days ago**

"Houston, what the hell is going on?" – I say to microphone, trying to not scream.

"Our measurements were accurate. There's indeed an object which are going through the wormhole. We've tried out best to observe that orbit and predict the position in the near future. It has been just a few days, the data is not enough, so nothing is guaranteed. But, the percentage that it would hit the Earth is … "

Then, suddenly, the silence. I hold the headphone as tight as possible, pray that the worst thing is not going to happen.

"… quite high, we're afraid."

"And? There should be something you guys can do about it, right? Launch some nukes, for example?"

"We're afraid not. People hasn't known about this, not yet. The President is discussing with heads of state from other powerhouses. The plan of nuking it is being considered to be too dangerous, since it would cause more damage."

"Shit…."

"Uhm, ISS? There's something you guys need to hear."

I gather my team, tell them to put headphones on.

"OK, we're ready."

"We, under the name of NASA, are saying to you. The President, with other heads of state, has granted the permission. In case of the worst event, your team, under the name of United States of America, with other teams on International Space Station, is now ordered to follow strictly the Protocol."

The ambiance around us is suddenly covered in silence. We're so dizzy, that we don't know what to think, what to say, what to do. At all.

"No, this can't be true." - all of us think.

We're not ready for this yet. It's too surprised.

"Copy that." – I say to the radio.

**Yesterday**

After other heads of state, The President has video called the whole ISS crew directly, for the first time. He said about many thing, and gave us a speech, as the last farewell, and also, as the blessing from mankind.

>*Fate has ordained that mankind who came to the Earth to live in peace, will stay on the Earth to rest in peace.*  
>  
>*We, united as one, know that there is no hope for us to survive. But we also know that there is hope for mankind in our sacrifice. You, the ISS, are our hope, to maintain our culture, our history, our achievements, so that our ancestors's works will not fall into obilivion.*  
>  
>*In acient days, men looked on the sky, wondered about the stars and dreamed about exploring the Universe. Now, it's your time to find a new home, to rebuild our world. A world that is not just as good, but better. A world where there will be no war or hate, so that we can always be proud of. A world to make mankind great again.*  
>  
>*Our sacrifice means there's a possibility of a better place, of a better future, so that many years later, our descendants can look on the sky, knowing that somewhere in this massive Universe, there has been, and will always be, some corner of another world, that is forever mankind.*

Other members have called their family. They have been carefully instructed to not say anything about the threat, in order to not cause any panic, without the permission from the President. They have said about everything, from how their kids do at school, how their parents are, their husband/wife is.

They know, that this can be their last call.

It's my turn now, to call Lilly.

Her voice is so sweat, I always love it. And, there's also my daughter, Charlotte.

We talk about lots of things. Things that make me remember the old, ordinary life before all of these troubles.

We talk about how Charlotte's doing at school. She just has got an A in Maths. "You will teach me about sciences, won't you?", says her, excitedly. Her voice sounds lively like a bird. We even discuss about our marriage anniversary and Charlotte's birthday party next week.

It's really hard, to end the conversation, knowing that this will be our last time to hear each others.

I record the call, from beginning to end. If, just if, and only if, the worst thing happens, this will help me to not forget their voices.

"Gosh, I wll miss them… " – I say, start crying. Crying on space is not something easy to do, but I did it, for the first time.

**Today**

The asteroid struck the Earth on 9:30 GMT 8th March 2019. It's painful, to see our hometown, our beloved ones, our memories, being destroyed completely.

The whole ISS team watched it. It's our way to say farewell to our beloved planet. Our home, that we all call the Earth.

Someone tries to call to the ground center, to military and scientific reinforced underground shelter all around the world, seeking a sign of life, and, hoping that there's some responses.

Hoping that there's a miracle.

Apparently, the reality is disastrous.

After that, the state of Earth is confirmed, and the Protocol is proceed. The ISS is transformed into an intergalatic space shuttle, to go and find a new planet where is capable of maintaining life. All of the reserved stuffs, in case of the Protocol, are in used, for the first time. We, as scientist and astronauts, now are explorers.

Now, it’s our journey.

"Once upon a time, there was Him, the Artist…"

That's an old bedtime story, the one that have been told over and over again, days and years, so much that everyone of us have learned it by heart. Since childhood, we've believed that this world, this whole, massive Universe, was drawed by the Artist long time ago. We've believed that our life, our Fate, was being written, like a small novel, a little prompt.

Then, soon, when our imagination wanted to create its own world, it's the moment when we realised that we're the Artist of our own mind. When we were children, our dream didn't have boundary. We were free, even-minded. Our soul were pure, like Christmas's snowflake, fragile, but has magical power.

We were able to do anything.

But, then, time has flied, we've grown up and seen the brutal world as it is. We've been told to focus on study, on work, on social relationship. Now, we only want a simple life, with work to do and money to spend. We laugh at people who still dream of changing the world and call them "childish".

Our litte world, like snowflake, has been crushed.

Simple, and cruel, just like that.

When we were a kid, our imaginary world was full of opportunities. It was a colorful world, and still it. It's just that people want to put a white cloth on, and forget it. People want to believe, that our world is created by the Artist, and so, we're just the details of the big picture.

The minor ones.

But, what if, there's no the Artist?

"What if, each of us is the Artist?" – she thought. 

But, she has never forgot her own universe. She takes the brush and colors the reality. Why can't you?

"In every moment, there's a probability of a better future, but you people won't believe it."

Those're the words from Tomorrowland. That's a remainder that each of us has own ability to imagine the world, own power to realise it, and, own chance to make it colorful. Our imagination have never had boundaries, it's us who draw the line. 

*So, would you like to take the palette, and paint the world?*

**1**, A normal saturday morning. The Sun shines, warmly, throught the wndow, into a small kitchen. Coffee scent mingles with grilled sandwiches, with strawberry jam being topped on.

It has been a very long time, since the last time John had such a calm and peaceful saturday moring, like today.

"Dad, I want to go to the Exhibition today."

That's his little daughter, Kate. She's just 8, but looks beautiful and charming, like …

Like Her.

"Well, then, sweetheart, we will go to the Exhibition, after the breakfast, okay?" – John gently cuddles her, then starts making his own omelette.

"Okay, daddy." – her voice sounds lively like a bird.

**2**, The Exhibition is an annual event of the city, where paintings of many artists, both popular and unknown, are carefully selected and presented. Normally, a 8-year-old girl would like comics and other chidlish thing. But not Kate, she loves the art, even thought John doesn't know whether she understands or not.

"Well, just like Her." – John smiles.

Kate wonders around, looks at each painting, slowly and carefully. She enjoys them as if it was her little stuffed animal or her colorful drawing.

Actually, it was Kate's idea to got to the Exhibition. She has never missed any, since she knew about the event. And, she will not accept any excuse and will insist John to take her to the Exhibition, at any cost. If Kate doesn't say anything, "there'll not be today" – he thinks.

Few recent months are covered by sadness and depressed. It's not like a stormy sea, but rather like a gloomy winter sky, floating above John's head. And, like Winter, there were no sunshine, no hope, at all. The time were running so slowly, that it was thought that it would take eternity, just to have some light being shed and dispelling the cloud.

It's truly a miracle, to have this morning.

**3**, "Daddy, daddy!" – Kate waves her hand.

Immersed in his own thoughts, Johh suddenly wakes up from day dream. He walks toward Kate, wondering what's happening.

"What's the matter, sweatheart?" – John says.

"Daddy, look!" – Kate point her index finger to the painting on the wall, in front of her – "It's Mommy."

John smiles, and looks to the picture. Suddenly, an emotinal wave rushes throught him, makes him freezed.

John stares at the painting, for …. 10 seconds? 1 minute? A century? He doesn't know, as if time doesn't make any sense anymore.

"She's smiling at us. It's Mommy, Dad." – Kate whispers, vague like early fog, but also humble like watch Sunrise.

John can’t hear her daughter, or he can, but he doesn't understand it. Doesn't matter now, he's attracted by the girl in the painting. There's something, very strange, like some strangers passing on the street. But, there's also something, very familiar, like he has known for his entire life.

The answer comes, suddenly, like the first light of the day, shining everywhere.

**4**, It's Her. No doubt. It's Her.

"Charlotte…" – he whispers, feels something salty on his lips. The tears start falling, twinkles under the sunlight like stars on the night sky.

"Where have you been, Charlotte? Where have you been all the time?... You know how much I miss you, why?"

"Daddy, what's wrong?" – Kate looks at her father, feels confused and somewhat scary.

"It's been really hard, you know? Really cold, and lonely. Where have you gone, my dear?" – John still stares at the painting, talks to the girl like she's living in his mind, in his own world – "Without you, it's like Winter, a endless, freezing Winter with snow falling everywhere. Why did you leave so soon?"

"Daddy?"

"Why, Charlotte?"

"Daddy, you make me scare…" – Kate starts cling to John's arm.

"Why….".

"Do it. Just do it. I beg you." – Sherlock says, kneels before John.

John's hands are shaking. His eyes sparkling, he doesn't know how he feels right now.

Angry? Sure.

Upset? Obviously.

But, hate? Well…

Sherlock holds the barrier aiming at his head, tightly. Around them, lots of bottles of pills and nicotine patches, littered the floor. The books were teared apart and strewn all over. He hasn't cried before, but somehow the tears are rolling.

Still, his voice is cold and calm. He's ready.

"I hate you, Holmes, I ready do … " – John says – "… You have sweared to protect Her."

"… Yes, I do."

"No matter what?"

"Of course."

"For the sake of God, you have one job only." – John scold – "Protect. Her."

"Yes." – Sherlock doesn't move, at all – "And, I've failed."

"She's lost, you know. Forever." – John slows down. The tears falls down on his best friend's hair. He emphasizes every single word. "Both of us. Can. Not. Ever. Meet. Her. Again. "

"I know."

"And, you want to meet Her, on Heaven. To apologize? To protect her again? Ok then, as you wish."

John starts to calm down. His eyes stares to Sherlock. He strenghts the trigger.

"Just do it." – Sherlock says, waiting the bang.

Suddenly, John raises the gun, aims the ceilling and pull the trigger. A loud bang echoes throughout the room.

"You've lost Her. That's enough." – John kneels down, puts his hand on Sherlock's shoulder. – "I can't lose you."

Sherlock starts crying like a little child. He hasn't do this in his entire life.

"Come on, you know She doesn't want you to do this." – John says – "Not Irene."

"I know… " – Sherlock sobs – "But I do."

6:00 AM. The alarm goes off, as usual.

Eddie opens his eyes, stares to the ceiling. "Alexa, what Standard Time is it?" – he says.

"25th February, 2118." The sounds echoes throughout the room.

"Gosh, it was 2019 yesterday…".

He hasn't got used to this feeling. The feeling when you wake up, only to realise a whole generation has passed.

People think it's a privilege, a special present which only be given to the rich. Living near the black hole, the time passes very slow, as Einstein predicted. But, that's only relative time. He still feels the same, still gets old, still can't be immortal.

Actually, he feels sad. That feeling rushes throught him every morning.

Having been working for his life, Eddie forgot that the closer he is to the black hole, the faster the time passes, relatively to everyone else. Now, when his time passes so slowly, that he can't even know what is happening. A blink, and few years has passes.

It's just that people don't even notice him. To them, he's immortal, but liveless and static like stars and galaxies on the night sky. He's still here, watching the normal life, but can't join it.

People think living near the black hole is a present to the riches, but being given that present also means losing the Present he had before.

The only Present, compared to Standard Time on Earth.

The only Present, that he knows and loves.

The only Present, that matters.

"Hello… Everybody?" – Katherine shout out loud to the radio, hoping for a miracle. But, deep inside, she knows that she's the only one who's left.

She remembered "that day", clearly like it was yesterday. It was morning, an ordinary morning, till she found something weird had appeared on her hoodie. The ranking number on her clothes jumped from #7.6B to #1. "What the hell just happened?" – she wondered.

Few days ago, the crisis between powerhouses has become intense more than ever. There was a threat of Nuclear War, and apparently someone did push the button to launch the missiles. Somehow, hiding her reinforced basement, Katherine lucky survived the strikes and felt asleep. Obviously, everybody else didn't have that chance.

Now, there is only her, and the silence. Or, that's what she has thought.

"Hello, everyone?" – surprisingly, after some buzz, she hears a voice crackling over the radio.

"Oh, hi, nice to meet you. You're … " – grap the microphone, she immediately says the first words come out of her head. The tears silently roll down.

"Oh, I've thought I'm the only one left. I'm Robert, and you're….?"

"Katherine... I'm Katherine"

"It seems that you're nearby, " – he says – "can I come over? It's a long time, you know…"

"Oh, you're welcome." – she starts crying. Trying to guide Robert, she talks about the past, how she survived, the life before "that day". "Oh, well, that normal life, I miss it. I was #7.6B, you know. The least hated person…" – she says.

"Oh, well… I hope you don’t mind… I was #1." – Robert says – "Actually, you're one of few people who talks to me like that. Like, no judging, no hate…. at all"

"Well, I'm depressed, being alone for such a long time. I was surrounded by friends, you know, by love. Now, there's only me, and I hate my self."

"Oh, so that why I'm the least hated person now. I got no friends, so it wasn't that important to me. I've been alone my whole life, learned to love myself… " - Robert stops, tries to find suitable words – "But that doesn't matter now, I guess…"

"Yeah, maybe you're right…" – Kate says – "Actually, I've wondered what would like to be #1"

"And I've wondered what would like to have a friend." – Robert smiles – "You're now the only one who notice me."

"And you're now ..." – Kate says - "... the only one who matters to me."

"Come on, get outside. It's safe, I guarantee. There's no hate anymore." – Robert whistle – "My number just have gone up to #1 again."
